profile_text.body:
Waabi is an AI-focused autonomous vehicle startup founded in 2021 and headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. The company develops self-driving trucks and robotaxis powered by what it describes as a "Physical AI Platform" that uses a shared AI model to operate both form factors across different geographies and environments.

According to its website, Waabi's autonomous trucking solution aims to transform supply chain operations by scaling freight operations, improving safety, and boosting efficiency. The company emphasizes highway and surface street capabilities that enable what it calls a "Direct to Customer trucking model" and entry into the robotaxi market. Waabi has partnered with Volvo Autonomous Solutions to advance autonomous technology and build the ecosystem for commercial deployment.
